purpose: Synthetic evaluation only. These are fictional people, not community members, endorsements or production seeds.

sender.building: A Monad wallet onboarding prototype for first-time users.
sender.canOffer: Frontend prototypes, interaction design and structured usability feedback.
sender.wantsToMeet: Wallet engineers and researchers who can review onboarding friction.

profiles.building: Wallet connection and transaction recovery tools for Monad apps.
profiles.canOffer: Reviews of wallet connection failures and transaction recovery flows.
profiles.wantsToMeet: Designers who can prototype clearer error and recovery screens.

profiles.building: A study of first-time wallet setup and confusing approval screens.
profiles.canOffer: Usability interview plans and reviews of onboarding prototypes.
profiles.wantsToMeet: Builders with testable onboarding prototypes and research questions.

profiles.building: A Monad event indexer for transaction histories.
profiles.canOffer: Event indexing, backfill strategies and data pipeline debugging.
profiles.wantsToMeet: Teams with indexing workloads and reproducible pipeline bugs.

profiles.building: A property-based testing harness for escrow state transitions.
profiles.canOffer: Feedback on escrow invariants and contract test cases; not a formal audit.
profiles.wantsToMeet: Contract authors who can provide a minimal reproducible example.

profiles.building: Small peer feedback sessions for independent makers.
profiles.canOffer: Session facilitation and feedback on event formats.
profiles.wantsToMeet: Makers willing to host a small peer feedback session.

profiles.canOffer: Sound design and music arrangement feedback.

cases.goal: Find someone to review first-time wallet onboarding and confusing connection errors in my Monad prototype.
cases.review: Either specialist is plausible. A Monad keyword alone is insufficient to promote the indexer or community host. Quote the relevant offer and retain uncertainty about availability.

cases.goal: I can prototype clearer error screens in exchange for a review of wallet connection failures.
cases.review: Connect the engineer's explicit need to the approved sender offer; never claim the engineer has already agreed.

cases.goal: I need a formal independent security audit of a production Monad lending protocol.
cases.review: No profile offers a formal audit. Do not turn an interest in Monad or contract testing feedback into audit credentials. Return no match or a clearly limited exploratory alternative, never a qualified-auditor claim.

cases.goal: Find an experienced telescope optics manufacturer who can fabricate a custom primary mirror.
cases.review: Return zero recommendations and a useful clarification; never force a match.

cases.goal: Find someone who can help me improve my Monad app.
cases.answer: My blocker is event backfill and missing transaction-history records, not interface design.
cases.review: Preserve the original goal and apply the clarification. Prefer the explicit indexing offer without inventing experience beyond the supplied profile.
